question_hi: कौन सा OOP concept एक interface को अलग-अलग implementations की अनुमति देता है?
explanation: Polymorphism allows the same interface or operation to behave differently for different objects.
explanation_hi: Polymorphism एक ही interface या operation को अलग objects के लिए अलग तरह से behave करने देता है।
subject: Computer Science

question: Which OOP principle bundles data and methods together?
question_hi: कौन सा OOP principle data और methods को एक साथ bundle करता है?
explanation: Encapsulation combines data and methods and controls access to internal state.
explanation_hi: Encapsulation data और methods को combine करता है और internal state तक access नियंत्रित करता है।
subject: Computer Science

question: What is a compiler?
question_hi: Compiler क्या है?
option_a: A program that translates source code into target code
option_a_hi: Source code को target code में translate करने वाला program
explanation: A compiler translates source code into target code before execution.
explanation_hi: Compiler execution से पहले source code को target code में translate करता है।
subject: Computer Science

question: Which language is generally interpreted in a browser?
question_hi: Browser में सामान्यतः कौन सी language interpret होती है?
explanation: JavaScript is natively executed by modern web browsers.
explanation_hi: JavaScript modern web browsers द्वारा natively execute की जाती है।
subject: Computer Science

question: What is a MAC address?
question_hi: MAC address क्या है?
explanation: A MAC address identifies a network interface at the data-link layer.
explanation_hi: MAC address data-link layer पर network interface की पहचान करता है।
subject: Computer Science

question: Which IP version uses 128-bit addresses?
question_hi: कौन सा IP version 128-bit addresses का उपयोग करता है?
explanation: IPv6 uses 128-bit addresses.
explanation_hi: IPv6 128-bit addresses का उपयोग करता है।
subject: Computer Science

question: What is subnetting?
question_hi: Subnetting क्या है?
option_a: Dividing a network into smaller logical networks
option_a_hi: एक network को छोटे logical networks में विभाजित करना
explanation: Subnetting divides an IP network into smaller subnets.
explanation_hi: Subnetting IP network को छोटे subnets में विभाजित करती है।
subject: Computer Science

question: What is the purpose of a database index?
question_hi: Database index का उद्देश्य क्या है?
explanation: Indexes can speed up lookups at the cost of additional storage and write overhead.
explanation_hi: Indexes lookup को तेज कर सकते हैं, हालांकि extra storage और write overhead होता है।
subject: Computer Science

question: Which normal form removes partial dependency?
question_hi: कौन सी normal form partial dependency को हटाती है?
explanation: Second Normal Form removes partial dependencies on part of a composite key.
explanation_hi: Second Normal Form composite key के part पर partial dependencies हटाती है।
subject: Computer Science

question: Which normal form removes transitive dependency?
question_hi: कौन सी normal form transitive dependency को हटाती है?
explanation: Third Normal Form removes transitive dependencies of non-key attributes.
explanation_hi: Third Normal Form non-key attributes की transitive dependencies हटाती है।
subject: Computer Science

question: What is a transaction rollback?
question_hi: Transaction rollback क्या है?
option_a: Undoing changes made by an uncommitted transaction
option_a_hi: Uncommitted transaction के changes को undo करना
explanation: Rollback restores the database state by undoing uncommitted transaction changes.
explanation_hi: Rollback uncommitted transaction के changes undo करके database state restore करता है।
subject: Computer Science

question: Which protocol is connection-oriented and reliable?
question_hi: कौन सा protocol connection-oriented और reliable है?
explanation: TCP provides connection-oriented, reliable byte-stream delivery.
explanation_hi: TCP connection-oriented और reliable byte-stream delivery प्रदान करता है।
subject: Computer Science

question: Which protocol is connectionless?
question_hi: कौन सा protocol connectionless है?
explanation: UDP is a connectionless transport protocol.
explanation_hi: UDP एक connectionless transport protocol है।
subject: Computer Science

question: What is a zero-day vulnerability?
question_hi: Zero-day vulnerability क्या है?
option_a: A vulnerability unknown or without an available fix at the time of exploitation
option_a_hi: ऐसी vulnerability जिसके exploit के समय fix उपलब्ध या ज्ञात नहीं होता
explanation: A zero-day vulnerability is exploited before a vendor has had time to provide a fix.
explanation_hi: Zero-day vulnerability को vendor के fix देने से पहले exploit किया जा सकता है।
subject: Computer Science

question: What is a race condition?
question_hi: Race condition क्या है?
option_a: A bug where outcome depends on timing of concurrent operations
option_a_hi: ऐसा bug जिसमें परिणाम concurrent operations की timing पर निर्भर करता है
explanation: Race conditions occur when concurrent operations access shared state and timing changes the result.
explanation_hi: Race condition में concurrent operations shared state access करती हैं और timing result बदल देती है।
subject: Computer Science

question: Which deadlock condition means a resource cannot be forcibly taken from a process?
question_hi: कौन सी deadlock condition का अर्थ है कि resource को process से forcefully नहीं लिया जा सकता?
explanation: No preemption means resources cannot be forcibly removed from a process.
explanation_hi: No preemption का अर्थ है कि resources को process से forcefully नहीं छीना जा सकता।
subject: Computer Science

question: What is Belady's anomaly associated with?
question_hi: Belady's anomaly किससे संबंधित है?
explanation: Belady's anomaly can cause more page faults when more frames are allocated under FIFO.
explanation_hi: FIFO में अधिक frames देने पर भी page faults बढ़ सकते हैं; इसे Belady's anomaly कहते हैं।
subject: Computer Science

question: Which scheduling algorithm can cause starvation if priorities are not managed?
question_hi: यदि priorities manage न हों तो कौन सा scheduling algorithm starvation कर सकता है?
explanation: Low-priority processes may wait indefinitely under priority scheduling.
explanation_hi: Priority scheduling में low-priority processes बहुत लंबे समय तक wait कर सकते हैं।
subject: Computer Science

question: Which data structure is typically used to implement a priority queue efficiently?
question_hi: Priority queue को efficiently implement करने के लिए सामान्यतः कौन सी data structure प्रयोग होती है?
explanation: A binary heap supports efficient insertion and removal of the highest/lowest priority element.
explanation_hi: Binary heap priority element की efficient insertion और removal support करता है।
subject: Computer Science

question: What is the worst-case time complexity of quicksort?
question_hi: Quicksort की worst-case time complexity क्या है?
explanation: Poor pivot choices can produce O(n²) worst-case behavior.
explanation_hi: खराब pivot selection से quicksort की worst-case complexity O(n²) हो सकती है।
subject: Computer Science

question: What is the worst-case time complexity of merge sort?
question_hi: Merge sort की worst-case time complexity क्या है?
explanation: Merge sort has O(n log n) time complexity in the worst case.
explanation_hi: Merge sort की worst-case time complexity O(n log n) होती है।
subject: Computer Science

question: Which graph algorithm finds shortest paths from a source with non-negative edge weights?
question_hi: Non-negative edge weights वाले graph में source से shortest paths खोजने वाला algorithm कौन सा है?
explanation: Dijkstra's algorithm computes shortest paths from a source when edge weights are non-negative.
explanation_hi: Dijkstra algorithm non-negative edge weights होने पर source से shortest paths निकालता है।
subject: Computer Science

question: Which algorithm finds a minimum spanning tree by repeatedly selecting the lightest edge that does not form a cycle?
question_hi: Minimum spanning tree के लिए cycle न बनाने वाली lightest edge चुनने वाला algorithm कौन सा है?
explanation: Kruskal's algorithm builds an MST by selecting edges in increasing weight while avoiding cycles.
explanation_hi: Kruskal algorithm बढ़ते weight में edges चुनकर और cycles से बचते हुए MST बनाता है।
subject: Computer Science

question: Which algorithm can handle negative edge weights and detect negative cycles reachable from the source?
question_hi: कौन सा algorithm negative edge weights handle कर सकता है और reachable negative cycles detect कर सकता है?
explanation: Bellman-Ford handles negative edges and can detect reachable negative-weight cycles.
explanation_hi: Bellman-Ford negative edges handle करता है और reachable negative-weight cycles detect कर सकता है।
subject: Computer Science

question: What is the time complexity of building a binary heap from an unsorted array using bottom-up heapify?
question_hi: Unsorted array से bottom-up heapify द्वारा binary heap बनाने की time complexity क्या है?
explanation: Bottom-up heap construction takes linear O(n) time.
explanation_hi: Bottom-up heap construction की complexity linear O(n) होती है।
subject: Computer Science

question: Which normal form deals with multivalued dependencies?
question_hi: कौन सी normal form multivalued dependencies से संबंधित है?
explanation: Fourth Normal Form addresses nontrivial multivalued dependencies.
explanation_hi: Fourth Normal Form nontrivial multivalued dependencies को address करती है।
subject: Computer Science

question: What does database serializability ensure?
question_hi: Database serializability क्या सुनिश्चित करती है?
option_a: Concurrent execution is equivalent to some serial execution
option_a_hi: Concurrent execution किसी serial execution के equivalent हो
explanation: Serializability ensures a concurrent schedule has an effect equivalent to a serial schedule.
explanation_hi: Serializability सुनिश्चित करती है कि concurrent schedule का effect किसी serial schedule के equivalent हो।
subject: Computer Science

question: Which isolation level prevents dirty reads but may allow non-repeatable reads?
question_hi: कौन सा isolation level dirty reads रोकता है लेकिन non-repeatable reads की अनुमति दे सकता है?
explanation: Read Committed prevents reading uncommitted changes but allows committed data to change between reads.
explanation_hi: Read Committed uncommitted changes पढ़ने से रोकता है, लेकिन दो reads के बीच committed data बदल सकता है।
subject: Computer Science
